code_block:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web-frontend-svc
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: web-frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: web-frontend
  annotations:
    # This annotation is an example for AWS to specify the health check path.
    # Replace with the appropriate annotation for your cloud provider.
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-healthcheck-path: /healthz
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  # For production, consider setting externalTrafficPolicy to "Local"
  # to preserve the client source IP and avoid a second network hop,
  # but this may result in uneven traffic distribution.
  # externalTrafficPolicy: Local
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: web-frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: web-frontend
  ports:
    - name: http
      protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
    - name: https
      protocol: TCP
      port: 443
      targetPort: https
